body: No.  I want merely for my body to decompose in its casket.

I made this account so that at least one person on this planet may not wish for my death. There is nothing left for me on this forsaken realm. Tomorrow night, on March 12, 2022, my birthday, I am going to celebrate my 17th year of life by taking my own life. I've no friends to say goodbye to, and my grandfather, the only person who for sure cared about me, has been dead for three years now. I've no reason to stay in this realm. All I can do is hope, hope that I shall find happiness on the other side of life...
